# telnyx_external_requirement_sub_number_order (Data Source)

The details of an action requirement of a sub number order.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `regulatory_requirement_id` (String)
- `sub_number_order_id` (String) The sub number order.

### Read-Only

- `fields_required` (Attributes List) The fields the end user must provide to fulfill this requirement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields_required))
- `requirement_action` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requirement_action))

<a id="nestedatt--fields_required"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields_required`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String) The field name to send inside the `requirement` object on the POST.
- `type` (String)
- `value` (String) The value already stored for this field, or null if not yet provided.


<a id="nestedatt--requirement_action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requirement_action`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The type of action the end user must complete.
- `value` (String) The action value. For ID verification this is the verification link URL, or null until it has been generated.
